title: Thales S.A - proposed acquisition of Gemalto N.V

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
Former provisional decision date of 6 December 2018 delayed while ACCC is awaiting information from parties. ACCC will announce a proposed decision date in due course.
ACCC received information from the parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition, subject to a section 87B undertaking accepted by the ACCC.

body_sections.Summary: French company Thales proposed to acquire Dutch company Gemalto. In Australia, both companies supplied data security products, including enterprise encryption software and hardware security modules.
